# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities through this repository's private vulnerability
reporting form under the **Security** tab. Do not open a public issue containing
exploit details, credentials, personal data, or information about an affected
Whop account.

Include the affected endpoint or source path, reproduction steps, impact, and
any suggested mitigation. Whop will acknowledge the report and coordinate
disclosure after a fix is available.

For account or transaction support that is not a software vulnerability, use
[Whop Support](https://whop.com/help).
